changes.question: I'm playing Cleric Class Deck Kyra in The Ancient Library. I defeat the Headless Lord using a Sword, but I don't close the location. The Ancient Library shuffles the Headless Lord back into its deck as I draw an armor from the box, then Kyra's power lets me explore. So I do it again, and again, and again. Now all the armor in the box is in my hand! Yay?
